verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anoch winh t'a spuerta'il templo t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Haxo ix wilani, ay jun ha ha' sk'eul t'a yalanh sti' puerta chi'. Ha jun ha ha' chi' sb'atkan ha' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, t'a ko wach' ayik tzonh elta t'a templo chi', tzek' ha' t'a stojolal sur t'a jun altar.

Ixlajwi chi', ix in yik'anelta winh t'a spatik b'ab'el amak' chi', t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal norte. Ix b'at woyan in b'a t'a spatik amak' chi' yuj winh, masanto t'a jun puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix wilani, ay jun ha' yune' ha' sk'eul t'a stojolal sur t'a jun puerta chi'.

Ha jun winh chi', ix b'at winh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, yet'nak jun ch'anh ch'anh winh yik echlab'. Ix yechtan 500 metro winh, ix in yik'anek' winh t'a yol ha ha' chi', ha t'a sjaj wok ix k'eul ha'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yechtanxi 500 metroxo winh, ix in yik'anxi ek' winh t'a yol ha'. Haxo t'a sjolom in penek ix k'eul ha'. Ix yechtanxi 500 metroxo winh, ix in yik'anxi ek' winh t'a yol ha'. Haxo t'a in nanhal ix k'ek'och ha'.
Ix yechtanxi 500 metroxo winh. Ha ha' chi' te niwan ix aj ha', manhxalaj mach syal sk'axpaj t'a yol ha'. Te jul ix aj yich ha', syal kek'i, palta toxonhej sko mak'a'.
Ix yalan winh t'ayin: Ach anima, scham wal a na'an tas ix il tik, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix in yik'anxikot winh t'a stitak ha ha' chi'.
Haxo ix wilani, manhxo jantakok te te' ay t'a stitak ha' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winh t'ayin: Ha jun ha' tik, sb'at ha' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, sb'atnhej ha' t'a sch'olanil ha' Jordán, sb'atkan ha' t'a yol ha' mar Muerto. Ayik ol k'och ha' t'a yol ha' chi', ol chib'okk'e ha' mar chi' yuj ha'.

Yalxonhej b'aj ol k'och jun ha' tik, wach' ol kajnaj masanil makanhil nok' nok' t'a yol ha', manhxo jantakok nok' chay ol k'ib'ok. Yujto a jun ha' tik, ol chib'okk'e ha ha' k'achi' yuj ha', ol te k'ib' tastak ay sk'inal t'a yol ha'.

Tzijtum heb' yamum chay ol aj t'a sti' ha'. Ha t'a En-gadi masanto t'a En-eglaim ol yak' takjok schimpa heb' yamum chay chi'. Manhxo jantakok makanhil nok' chay ol k'ib' t'a ha', icha smakanhil schayil ha' mar Mediterráneo.
Haxo pax stitak ha' sok'omtak, ma b'aj ay ha' kotak nhajab', manh ol chib'oklaj ha', hata' ay ha ha' k'achi', hata' ol yik'k'eta yatz'am anima.

Ha t'a stitak ha ha' chi', ol k'ib'k'e masanil makanhil te te' sloji sat. Ha te te' chi', malaj b'ak'inh sk'ajb'anem xi'il te'. Manh ol yaktejpax yak'an sat te'. Junjun uj syak'nhej sat te', yujto ha ha' tz'elta t'a templo ayoch yalok te'. Ha sat te' chi', ol lochajok, haxo xil te' ol och remeyoal, xchi winh t'ayin.
Ix yalan Jehová Yajal t'ayin icha tik: Haton stz'akanhil lum lum ol scha' lajchawe' makan heb' yinhtilal Israel smakb'enok. (Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj José cha makan smakb'en heb' ol yik'a'.
Ha in ix wak' in ti' wak'an jun lum tik t'a heb' he mam yicham. Lajannhej tz'aj he pukanek' lum t'a he kal he lajchawe' inhtilal. Haton jun lum tik ol wak' he makb'enok.)
Haton stz'akanhil lum tik t'a jun pak'anh t'a stojolal norte: Schael t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo, sk'och t'a chonhab' Hetlón yet' t'a chonhab' Zedad,
Hamat, Berota yet' Sibraim, haton ay t'a skal stz'akanhil Damasco yet' Hamat masanto sk'och t'a Hazar-hatikón, haton stz'akanh sb'a yet' Haurán.
Yuj chi', a stz'akanhil lu'um schael t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo masanto sk'och t'a Hazar-enán. Haxo t'a norte skan lum yik chonhab' Damasco yet' lum yik Hamat.

Haxo stz'akanhil lum t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haton tik: Tz'ek' t'a stitak lum yik chonhab' Haurán yet' yik Damasco. Sb'atnhej t'a stitak ha' Jordán, haton ha' chi' tz'akanh yaj t'a skal chonhab' Galaad yet' Israel, masanto sk'och t'a chonhab' Tamar t'a stojolal sur t'a yik ha' mar Muerto.
Haxo pax stz'akanhil lum t'a stojolal sur, haton tik: Schael t'a chonhab' Tamar, tzek' t'a sjajtak ha' Meriba-cades yet' t'a ha' eluma' yik Egipto, masanto sk'och t'a ha' Mediterráneo.

Haxo pax t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ha ha' mar Mediterráneo ayoch stz'akanhilok lu'um. Schael t'a stz'akanhil yik Egipto tzek'nhej t'a sti' ha' mar chi' masanto sk'och b'aj tzonh och t'a chonhab' Hamat.
Haton jun lum tik yowalil spukchajek' t'a he kal junjun makan ex yinhtilal Israel ex tik.
Ha lum ol eyik' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, haton heb' ayxo yuninal. Ayik ol he pukanek' lu'um t'a he kal, lajan lum yik heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi' ol yik' heyet'ok.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala' to a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', ol scha' smakb'en heb' yalnhej b'aj kajan t'a skal junjun inhtilal chi'.
